prior_year_events.impact_description: Syndicate 1110's 2017 year of account liabilities were reinsured to close into the 2022 year of account, transferring liabilities.
Syndicate 1110 entered into a reinsurance to close deal for all Syndicate 5678's open years of account.
Syndicate 1110 entered into an adverse development cover for certain years of account of Syndicates 33 and 3624.

named_events.loss_description: The 2017 year of account of Syndicate 1110 was reinsured to close into the 2022 year of account on 1 July 2023 following confirmation regarding reinsurance balances with Co/Action Specialty Group, who are the major reinsurer of the liabilities of this year of account.
RITC of all Syndicate 5678's open years of account was entered into in the prior year.
Adverse development cover of certain years of account of Syndicates 33 and 3624 ('Hiscox ADC') was entered into in the prior year.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's prior year development cannot be reliably quantified from the provided financial statements due to the lack of an explicit "Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding" note and the distortion of the claims development triangle by a reinsurance to close (RITC) event for the 2017 Year of Account. The Report of the Directors notes that the current year claims incurred were largely driven by adverse experience in casualty business and prior year deterioration. The syndicate also engaged in significant RITC and Adverse Development Cover deals in the prior year.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration in the claims reserves due to adverse trends in the frequency or size of claims, including the impact of inflation especially in longer tail classes
average claim costs, claim handling costs, claim inflation factors and claim numbers

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The 2017 Year of Account was reinsured to close into the 2022 Year of Account during 2023. This RITC event distorts the claims development triangle, making it unreliable for calculating prior year development. No explicit "Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding" note was found. The narrative on page 6 states "current year claims incurred... is prior year deterioration", but this refers to the total claims incurred figure, not a specific prior year reserve movement. Therefore, prior year development cannot be reliably quantified from the provided information.
